messages.subject: Re: value.name argument of melt() still ignored under R 2.14
parts:
Hadley stated that the problem would be fixed with ggplot2 0.90. He said nothing about it being fixed with R 2.14. 

There was a thread a few days ago now where the solution was something like reshape2::melt.data.frame() since melt() calls melt.data.frame but it doesn't care where it comes from so it goes for the reshape1 version and ignores the names. 

Brandon
